facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet centered on one adult man shown in different views; the panels are not separate characters.
The large top panel labeled HERO shows the man standing on a wet urban walkway or street at night, with metal railings on both sides, visible rain and reflective pavement.
He wears a dark high-collared tactical jacket with straps and buckles, a dark shirt, black cargo-style trousers and black lace-up combat boots.
The middle row contains three full-body views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE and BACK, all against a dark neutral background.
The bottom row contains four detail crops labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS.
The face detail shows close-cropped hair with shaved sides, a small tied topknot or bun, and a visible scar line near one brow.
The lighting is low-key and cool, with warm amber point lights and wet-surface reflections visible in the hero panel.
The visible labels are all uppercase: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS.
